caption: The drawing features a bust of a man depicted in tones of brown and beige, with visible patches and texture suggesting wear or aged material. The bust shows the figure with a short, curly beard, mustache, and wavy hair, and he is dressed in a loose, collared garment with detailed folds. The bust rests on a rectangular pedestal that is colored brown, with the name "PARACELSUS" written in large, uppercase, yellow-orange letters on the front. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Bust of Paracelsus
